title: Progress and errors over the websocket

questions.q: Which message arrives for every job, whatever happened?
questions.why: prompt_worker sends it after every job. The others depend on the job.

questions.q: A job is fully cached. What is missing compared with a first run?
options: progress and executing for each node
questions.answer: progress and executing for each node
questions.why: In the capture no node ran, and the output node still reported its file.

questions.q: Your connection drops as a job finishes. What should you do on reconnect?
options: Wait, the server replays the messages
questions.why: There is no replay. The history keeps the status and the messages.

questions.q: Why might a script see progress from a job that isn't its own?
options: A job with no client_id sends progress to everyone
questions.answer: A job with no client_id sends progress to everyone
questions.why: sid None means all sockets, so compare prompt_id.

questions.q: Why does the official example skip the first 8 bytes of a preview frame?
options: 4 bytes of event type and 4 of image format
questions.answer: 4 bytes of event type and 4 of image format
questions.why: encode_bytes adds the first and send_image writes the second.
